capabilities: receive messages from a Telegram bot
append received messages to the daily note
restrict incoming messages to allowed usernames or Telegram IDs
queue messages on Telegram servers for up to 24 hours when the plugin is not running
extras: Setup depends on third-party Telegram bots (@BotFather for bot creation, @Get_UIDbot for getting your user ID); README includes manual build/install instructions requiring Node.js and pnpm.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture incoming Telegram messages, so thoughts sent from a phone or chat must be copied into notes by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin can receive messages from Telegram bots and add them to Obsidian's daily note.

requires.name: Telegram user ID for the Allowed Users list

summary: Telegram integration that receives messages sent to a Telegram bot and appends them to the Obsidian daily note.
